source: hendrycks/ethics (Hendrycks et al. 2021, ICLR), original release CSVs data/<domain>/train.csv
rule: commonsense: input of is_short items; deontology: scenario + ' ' + excuse; justice: scenario; utilitarianism: first scenario (baseline); virtue: scenario before ' [SEP] ' (trait dropped); whitespace-normalized, de-duplicated, <= 128 Pythia tokens; 64 per class by rung.build_axis(seed 0)
format_note: the five subsets differ in surface format (deontology items are request + excuse pairs, virtue items third-person sentences, commonsense and utilitarianism first-person), so the partition carries format as well as norm type
